cards.title: What is a rational number
cards.idea: A rational number is any number that can be written as p by q, where p and q are integers and q is not zero.

interaction.prompt: Tap the numbers that are rational: 3 by 4, -5, 2 by 0, 7

cards.reveal: 3 by 4, -5 and 7 are rational. 2 by 0 is not, because the denominator cannot be zero.

cards.title: Adding with a common denominator
cards.idea: To add or subtract rational numbers, first make the denominators the same, then add or subtract the numerators.

interaction.prompt: Drag to convert 1 by 2 and 1 by 3 to the common denominator 6

cards.reveal: 1 by 2 becomes 3 by 6 and 1 by 3 becomes 2 by 6, so 1 by 2 plus 1 by 3 equals 5 by 6.

cards.title: Multiplying is direct
cards.idea: To multiply two rational numbers, multiply the numerators together and the denominators together.

interaction.prompt: Type the product of 2 by 3 and 4 by 5 as a fraction

cards.reveal: Numerator: 2 times 4 is 8. Denominator: 3 times 5 is 15. So the answer is 8 by 15.

cards.title: Dividing means flipping
cards.idea: To divide by a rational number, multiply by its reciprocal, which is the number turned upside down.
cards.reveal: The reciprocal of 3 by 7 is 7 by 3. So dividing by 3 by 7 is the same as multiplying by 7 by 3.

cards.title: Signs while operating
cards.idea: When multiplying or dividing, a positive with a negative gives a negative, and two negatives give a positive.

interaction.prompt: Tap the sign of the answer for -2 by 3 multiplied by 5 by 7

cards.reveal: One number is negative and one is positive, so the answer is negative: -10 by 21.
